scenes.dialogue: On the thirtieth of October, twenty twenty six, Honourable Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari of the Madras High Court answered that question.
scenes.shown: On 30 October 2026, Honourable Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari of the Madras High Court answered that question.

scenes.dialogue: Under a twenty sixteen land aggregator agreement, the petitioners say, the respondent would get them the plot next to theirs, for ninety lakh rupees, paid in cash.
scenes.shown: Under a 2016 land aggregator agreement, the petitioners say, the respondent would get them the plot next to theirs, for ₹90 lakh, paid in cash.

scenes.dialogue: In January twenty twenty three, the respondent wrote that he had acquired the plot. But then, they say, he gave a power of attorney to a third party instead.
scenes.shown: In January 2023, the respondent wrote that he had acquired the plot. But then, they say, he gave a power of attorney to a third party instead.

scenes.dialogue: They sought an arbitrator under Section Eleven, and an injunction under Section Nine. The respondent's answer: the agreement is forged, and no money was paid.
scenes.shown: They sought an arbitrator under Section 11, and an injunction under Section 9. The respondent's answer: the agreement is forged, and no money was paid.

scenes.dialogue: He cited the Supreme Court in Rajia Begum: when an agreement's existence is seriously disputed as forged, the dispute is not arbitrable at that stage.
But Rajia Begum, the Court held, had exceptional facts, like a document missing for nearly nine years. Here, the respondent's own letter acknowledged acquiring the plot.
His pleas also contradicted each other. So the forgery plea was a thin veil, the Court found, and under Salson Liquors, the arbitrator can decide it first.
The petition was allowed. A retired High Court judge was appointed sole arbitrator. The interim order continues till his Section Seventeen ruling.
scenes.shown: The petition was allowed. A retired High Court judge was appointed sole arbitrator. The interim order continues till his Section 17 ruling.
